name: Phaseah
overview: Phaseah, also referred to as Paseah, is identified in Scripture as an ancestor of a family that returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian captivity. The genealogical records in Ezra 2:49 and Nehemiah 7:51 mention the descendants of Phaseah among the returning exiles, highlighting their role in the restoration community. Furthermore, Nehemiah 3:6 records Jehoiada, the son of Paseah, actively participating in the physical rebuilding of Jerusalem's gates, demonstrating the family's commitment to the city's spiritual and physical renewal after exile.
